summary: Arterial kerb with no parked cars and no room to pull out of the lane.
reasons: Main road, no parking lane or parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Retail building 11 m away; nearest dwelling 26 m (house) and 28 m (apartments); open to the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb lane of a busy through road, footpath directly behind the kerb; no cars parked along it and no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Constant traffic on a multi-lane arterial near a junction.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this kerb and no signs here.

sun_shade: Open to sky; the building to the east shades the kerb in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the Clearway on the neighbouring kerb extends here
